name: office-hours
title_zh: 六个逼问戳破需求幻觉的 YC 式办公时间
tagline_zh: 别再说「 brainstorm 一下」就完事。它用六连问逼你交代真实需求、现状、死忠细节、最窄切入点。
tagline_en: Stop vague brainstorming. Six forcing questions expose demand reality, status quo, desperate specifics, the.
desc_en: YC-style office hours. Two modes. Startup mode runs six forcing questions that expose demand reality, status quo, desperate specificity, the narrowest wedge, what you learned from watching users, and future-fit. why_zh: 不是聊天机器人附和的头脑风暴，而是带刺的陪练。每个问题都逼你从「我觉得」落到「我见过谁在什么场景下非用…
why_en: Not a nodding chatbot—a sharp sparring partner. Each question forces you from "I think" to "I saw who needs this, when, and why.
limit_zh: 只认两种模式：Startup 和 Builder。Startup 模式不碰融资、定价、团队搭建。
limit_en: Only two modes: Startup (no funding/pricing/team advice) and Builder (no pure execution on a clear spec). Outputs are a design doc + one.
